cards.title: Rooms of every shape
cards.text: Rooms now come in many shapes and sizes, both ways. Your other map notes are in too. Live now as 0.4.0.
cards.why: This is how every room plays from now on. The clip is one plus-shaped room at triple speed. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details:
Four full test runs, 30 rooms each, none stuck. Still won every time, so balance waits for the progression in stage 3.

Without a potion to start with, the rogue went down in the clip's first room, so it's a little harder than before.

parts.title: Room shapes
parts.text: Rooms are built from screen-sized pieces: long strips, boxes, squares up to 3 screens each way, L, T, plus and S shapes. Pieces left out are rock. Big rooms sometimes have square blocks in them; long strips keep the walls from before.

parts.title: Camera both ways
parts.text: The camera follows the party sideways as well as forward. Drag in any direction to look around; it eases back after a couple of seconds.

parts.title: Walking the room
parts.text: With nothing in sight, the party walks to the nearest part of the room it hasn't seen, so it finds every group, and goes to the doors last.

parts.title: Coins
parts.text: Coins stay where they drop. A hero has to walk over them, and they blink out after 7 seconds. Heroes grab nearby coins when they aren't busy fighting, and collect what's left after the fight.

parts.title: Rogue backs up
parts.text: After a hit, the rogue backs away still facing the enemy, a bit slower, instead of turning round to run.

parts.title: No wobble
parts.text: The side-to-side waddle is gone; only a small step bounce is left until arms swing with the new art.

parts.title: Doors and spikes
parts.text: Doors are archways in the wall: a shut wooden door during the fight, open after, lit on the one the party takes. What's behind each is on a stone plaque in front. Spikes are now an iron grate of spike tips.

parts.title: Wider tree
parts.text: Each layer of the floor has 2 to 5 rooms. The map at the top just shows rooms done, where you are, rooms to go and the boss.

parts.title: Potions
parts.text: Heroes no longer start with a potion. Bringing one in will be something you buy at the camp (stage 3); chests and choice rooms still give them.
